style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

visibleSuccessCriteria.outcome: A clearly recognizable straight conveyor has softly modeled, coherent volume: warm coral continuous rails frame slate moving deck bands; support structure feels solid and intentionally built. Useful native form/structure/decor improvements are rewarded. Retaining old weak geometry or exact part counts is unnecessary. Connector profiles stay exact; target endcaps/oversized slats do not take priority over functional joins.

Coral/orange rails, blue-gray slate deck and honey-brown timber remain distinct and belong to the approved family. Warmth comes from readable surface color and soft value transitions. Wood no longer collapses into near-black featureless feet, and coral does not bleach to white or drift to saturated neon.

Broad, restrained highlights and soft shading communicate volume at game size, with no preferred horizontal illumination, view-specific exposure or hard directional ground shadow. Slate and rail edges separate cleanly; no blown hot streaks, flat dead panels, black patches or noisy sparkle across frames/facings.

Surface finish looks crafted and softly cartoon: readable slate separators, continuous rail edge treatment and restrained timber grain/trim or small structural details. Detail has consistent scale and weight across rotations and connects cleanly to the family. It remains subordinate to deck travel and does not become a collar or fastener pattern that marks every tile boundary.

At actual cell128, intermediate55 and phone32 the conveyor retains clear deck/rail/support separation, coherent visual weight and a clean alpha edge on light, gray/dark and game backgrounds. No clipping, exposed cut ends in joins, halos, coplanar speckles, abrupt normals, muddy merged forms, flicker, texture swimming, animated supports or unexpected cast shadows. All four actual facings are coherent even though the fixed target supplies only one view.

The deck travels in the original S-directed flow for every actual facing, shares phase/cadence with compatible family neighbors, and loops from index23 through the closure toindex0 with no perceptible step. All24+closure are inspected; stills at one phase cannot prove motion.

Three-module repeated S routes and compatible mixed approved-family routes read as a continuous conveyor. Native connected captures and independently assembled captured modules agree in rail/deck edge shape, height, slat phase and material color; no visible RGB or alpha seam, doubled edge, cap, gap or brightness stripe at either join. Assess interior support residuals explicitly as localized evidence, not as an automatic exception.

requiredEvidence.evidence: Immutable candidate packet binds source.blend, recipe/settings, resources, all96 unique native frame captures, closure renders, four-facing sheet, original-layout atlases, technical validation, motion and assembly/runtime previews. Review records exact packet SHA256 and only actually inspected files.

Reopen the actual candidate and enable original hidden collection/object viewport+render flags in an isolated active scene before evaluation. Update dependency graph for frame/root changes. Report actual camera matrices/calibration, root/orientation matrices, all-facing bounds, source-vs-candidate connector vertices/profiles, deck UVs, material-coordinate mapping/common family material graph/settings equality, real S node-tree/action ownership and all25 phase evaluations. Geometric evidence must establish compatibility rather than inferring it from image silhouettes.

Four actual facings, each with every24 native source-scale2 frame and frame25 closure, verified readable contact sheets with file/hash mapping, and playback at12fps. Inspect enlarged and at intended size over light and dark/gray contexts. Compare closure in RGBA/composited RGB as well as alpha and explain any nonzero residual.

For each actual facing and all24+closure, show repeated three-S modules and compatible mixed family connections with approved N, using N actual intrinsic orientation and root transforms; approved E may additionally serve as a technical joining reference. Include both native connected scene captures and independent module assembly, with two joins visible. Match incoming/outgoing port positions and tangent/phase, not direction labels alone; perpendicular straight pieces cannot form a valid90-degree join.

Use the exact approved unchanged Godot native-world consumer bound in family-settings.runtimeConsumer. Exercise repeated and compatible mixed routes at actual cell128,55,32, integer and fractional origins on contrasting light/dark/gray and representative game backgrounds. All24+closure and every actual facing require comparison coverage. Save actual Godot/GPU output pairs, consumer file hashes, test-matrix/case mapping and verified contact sheets. Pillow or an idealized resize alone is insufficient.

Compare connected and independent whole images using RGB and alpha, plus composited RGB on tested backgrounds, and report join-band and full-image residuals separately. Include residual bounds/heatmaps, pixel counts/maxima and worst-case original pairs. Attribute full-image residuals to exact deck/rail/support regions; do not hide RGB discrepancies behind alpha agreement. Tiny interior support shading residuals may be explicitly judged nonblocking only after visible actual-size/enlarged side-by-side inspection shows no material defect or join. No silent threshold waiver, alpha-only pass or unlocalized maximum.

reviewRules.approval: Approve only an exact hash-bound S candidate that visibly improves the original toward fixed target/family, passes all hard constraints and evidence, and has no material defects. Missing evidence is needs_evidence; visible unmet outcomes are revise. A family approval never substitutes for S judgment.
reviewRules.scores: Comparative1–10 scores with visible observations, not an automatic numeric pass threshold.
reviewRules.blockers: At most three ranked blockers with location, effect and desired visible outcome.
reviewRules.acceptedDifferences: Record any accepted target difference or localized support residual explicitly with inspected proof; never relax frozen criteria merely because implementation is difficult.
